headline: A Wrong Turn Becomes a Life-Saving Moment
meta_description: A stranger's misdirection led him to a burning home in Georgia, where he woke the father and helped rescue all 14 family members—12 foster children and their p…
summary_short: A stranger who took a wrong turn discovered a Georgia home on fire and helped save all 14 family members, including 12 foster children in their care.
body:
A chance misdirection became a lifeline for a Georgia family when a stranger's wrong turn led him to their burning home. He woke the father and helped get all 12 children out safely. All 14 family members—the couple and the children in their care—survived the fire.

The foster parents have dedicated their lives to caring for vulnerable children, having fostered more than 500 children over the years. That night, their home held 12 of those children when the fire broke out. The stranger's timely arrival and quick action proved decisive in ensuring no one was left behind.

What began as a navigation error became an act of grace—a moment when one person's presence at exactly the right time made all the difference for a family whose calling is to give children a safe place to belong.

Foster parents caring for 12 children at the time of fire
